changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT fa.physical_filename::STRING AS file_name, fa.client_token::STRING AS client, 'INBOUND' AS direction, (CASE WHEN fa.status = 'QUARANTINED' THEN 'QUARANTINE' WHEN fa.route_id = 'fint-resp' THEN 'FINT_REPLY' ELSE 'COPYBOOK' END)::STRING AS kind, fa.route_id::STRING AS route, fa.id AS arrival_id, NULL::UUID AS related_arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63) AS job_name, fa.arrived_at AS occurred_at, COALESCE(fa.quarantine_reason, fa.status)::STRING AS state, 'file_arrival' AS source_table FROM public.file_arrival fa UNION ALL SELECT dd.physical_filename::STRING, dd.client_token::STRING, 'INBOUND', 'DUPLICATE', dd.route_id::STRING, dd.original_arrival_id, dd.original_arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), dd.observed_at, 'DUPLICATE_REDELIVERY'::STRING, 'duplicate_delivery' FROM public.duplicate_delivery dd UNION ALL SELECT li.job_name::STRING, fa.client_token::STRING, 'INTERNAL', 'OUTCOME_SEAM', 'outcomes', li.arrival_id, NULL::UUID, li.job_name, li.created_at, li.status::STRING, 'launch_intent' FROM public.launch_intent li LEFT JOIN public.file_arrival fa ON fa.id = li.arrival_id ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT fa.id AS arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63) AS job_name, (CASE WHEN fa.status = 'QUARANTINED' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE 'ARRIVED' END)::STRING AS step, fa.arrived_at AS step_at, (fa.physical_filename || COALESCE('|' || fa.quarantine_reason, ''))::STRING AS detail, fa.id AS source_key, 'ARRIVAL' AS event_kind, 'ARRIVED_AT' AS time_kind, NULL::UUID AS intent_id, NULL::INT AS attempt, NULL::INT AS exit_code FROM public.file_arrival fa UNION ALL SELECT dd.original_arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'DUPLICATE_REDELIVERY', dd.observed_at, (dd.physical_filename || ' -> ' || dd.sunk_path)::STRING, dd.id, 'DUPLICATE', 'OBSERVED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.duplicate_delivery dd UNION ALL SELECT li.arrival_id, li.job_name, (upper(li.stage) || '_INTENDED')::STRING, li.created_at, li.job_name::STRING, li.id, 'LAUNCH', 'CREATED_AT', li.id, li.attempt, NULL::INT FROM public.launch_intent li UNION ALL SELECT li.arrival_id, li.job_name, (upper(li.stage) || '_' || so.outcome)::STRING, so.observed_at, ('exit=' || COALESCE(so.exit_code::STRING, '?'))::STRING, so.id, 'OUTCOME', 'OBSERVED_AT', li.id, so.attempt, so.exit_code FROM public.launch_intent li JOIN public.stage_outcome so ON so.intent_id = li.id ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')
